answer: A bond is refunded only after 27 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The comet counter is kept in dawn and garden publishes each reset. An hostile operator hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 27 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 229 aliases cost 260 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
